strengthVerdict: Separate practical-v4 evidence; not evaluated by this audit.

manifest.attribution: Replay MESSAGE is a self-reported identity. Matching the locally retained artifact verifies the marker mapping, not independently which source the server executed.

freshMaps.auditScope: All 500 already generated shared-core identities and exact seeds were independently checked against the complete recorded prior-source union; no maps regenerated or games played by this audit.

warmup.method: disposable bot on the fixed largest saved map; 36-ms slices, actual board unchanged
disposable bot on the fixed largest saved map; 36-ms slices, actual board unchanged

method.selection: all 40 previously pinned arena games, every turn 0..19, one paired pass
method.armOrder: V5 then V6 when (gameIndex+turn) even, V6 then V5 otherwise
method.memory: both bots and separate feature instances observe actual recorded board prefixes; previous accepted actual disruption overrides diagnostic target memory
method.rng: same deterministic per-state seed as prior probe; no claim of reconstructed CG RNG history
method.featureTrajectory: full preparation, sabotage rows/closure flags, then all build rows and incremental preparation on V5 chosen placements; actual replay alone advances the next turn

limitations: One local pass on reused positions; timings are development diagnostics, not CG deadline or strength evidence.
Both bots have real 60000-ms clocks; no interrupt was expected. Different interrupted decisions remain possible in actual timed games.
Two disposable warm-ups, V5 then V6, 500 ms each on the same fixed largest map; this is not full CG lifecycle emulation.
Warm-up order is fixed rather than counterbalanced, and both implementations share a JVM. Alternating measured arm order does not remove all JIT/GC/order effects.
Timing and allocation bracket bot.play only; input copies, feature differential checks, replay progression and reporting are excluded.
Same RNG per state isolates decision equivalence, but does not reconstruct historical arena random/JIT/scheduling state.
Inclusive existing prepare/sabotage/build counters are diagnostic only. Allocation counts do not identify GC pauses.
savedStateEquivalence.interpretation: Timing/allocation measure one fixed shared-JVM diagnostic pass. Exact features/actions establish equivalence at ample budget; neither cost differences nor equivalence alone establish CG deadline safety or arena strength.

processPanel.scope: Readiness only; not a strength estimate or a hard real-time guarantee. Failures retained without reruns.
processPanel.timingCaveat: A null responseMs means no completed response was observed by the deadline. sendMs includes host input preparation/write/flush; consumerMs includes host-side consumption timing. Aggregate IO latency cannot be attributed solely to bot CPU or allocation behavior.
